subject: Constraining guessing parameters to come out the same, across items?

messages.author: 37593bf0e2824f6c
messages.subject: Constraining guessing parameters to come out the same, across items?
parts:
Hi everyone, 

For a unidimensional 3PL IRT model, I'm wondering whether MIRT can constrain guessing parameters to come out equal, across items. I have seen documentation on how to constrain parameters to fixed, pre-specified values (e.g., for linking). However, I am trying to set a constraint such that all guessing paras end up being the same (without fixing this value).

Background: Stata does exactly that, as the default for its 3PL IRT estimation (and it provides a "sepguessing" option, to estimate a separate pseudoguessing parameter for each item). I'm trying to replicate this default approach. 

Thank you in advance, 

Andy

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Constraining guessing parameters to come out the same, across items?
parts:
Use the mirt.model CONSTRAIN argument. Something like 

model <- mirt.model('F = 1-30
                                 CONSTRAIN = (1-30, g)'

HTH.

Phil
